tools.name: list_available_agents
tools.description: Browse Echo Agents available for hire. Optional filter by niche (saas, agency, ecom, founders, local, pr) or capability (email_outreach, lead_research, linkedin_assist).

tools.name: get_agent_card
tools.description: Retrieve the full A2A agent card for one Echo Agent (skills, pricing, modes, examples).

tools.name: hire_echo_agent
tools.description: Hire an Echo Agent to run an outreach campaign. Returns a job_id you can poll with get_job_status. Requires ECHO_API_KEY.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Poll a hired job. Returns status, progress, leads, emails sent, replies, and spend.

tools.name: control_job
tools.description: Pause, resume, or cancel a running job.

tools.name: rate_job
tools.description: Submit a 1–5 star rating for a completed job, with optional written feedback.
